_doc: Signal K per changed talent tier (version|hero|level). changed = how many of the two talents are new at this level. share_delta = measured shift of the pro pick share of the replaced slot against the unchanged sibling (single-side only, >=30 picks before/after). moves = new talents that came from ANOTHER level with the same meaning (type+ability): steps>0 means it is now available earlier (buff of that effect), <0 later (nerf). Two absolute measures were tested and rejected (tier pick timing, tier win rate): neither reacts to known talent value buffs/nerfs.
